paragraphs: The 640d was part of the BMW 6 Series F06/F12/F13 generation, produced from 2012 to 2018. It uses the N57 — a 3.0-litre inline-six tri-turbo diesel, representing the top diesel option in the 6 Series range of that era. The N57 sits alongside the N55 and N63 petrol units in the F-series 6 Series lineup, and was offered across all three body styles — Coupe, Convertible, and Gran Coupe. The 6 Series was discontinued after this generation, with the role later taken by the 8 Series from 2018 onward.
about.boldParagraph: The 640d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the 640d uses the N57 tri-turbo configuration — which differs from other N57 variants used in the 3, 4 and 5 Series — fitting the wrong replacement or assuming parts from a single-turbo N57 will work risks a compatibility problem.
